aboutDescription: As a fresh graduate in Biology Education, I have developed a strong foundation in scientific methodology, laboratory techniques, research, and educational practices. I am a detail-oriented, organized, and continuous learner who values accuracy, collaboration, and meaningful contribution. Whether supporting educational activities, conducting research, managing data and administrative tasks, or working on digital projects, I bring the same level of dedication, responsibility, and willingness to learn to every opportunity.
